text:
The note doesn't hold up. With Ann in slot 7, Gus in slot 8 and Ivo in slot 9, Gus and Ivo would be adjacent. The constraints need exactly one person between them, so that arrangement fails.

I rechecked my earlier schedule against all 17 constraints, and it satisfies every one:
- Finn is in slot 1 and Hana is in slot 2, so Hana is immediately after Finn.
- Dev (4) and Hana (2) have one person between them.
- Dev and Finn are 3 slots apart.
- Elif (3) is before Ben (5), with one person between them.
- Ann (8) and Ben (5) are 3 apart.
- Ann and Hana are 6 apart.
- Ben and Ivo are 4 apart.
- Gus (7) and Ivo (9) have one person between them.
- Gus and Hana are 5 apart.
- Dev and Ivo are 5 apart.
- Cara (6) is before Gus (7) and before Ivo (9).
- Dev (4) is before Gus (7).
- Hana (2) and Elif (3) are both before Ivo (9).

I only tried the case where Ivo is two slots after Gus. I didn't check whether any other schedule fits, so I can't say this one is unique.

CONFIDENCE: 97
